rows.grounds: instrumental of huṅkāra, the utterance of the syllable huṃ
demonstrative pronoun referring to the demon
verbal compound with bhasmī and √kṛ, made into ashes

items.question: What power instantly reduced the foremost demon to ashes?
premises: The foremost demon was the target.
The huṃ-sound alone effected his destruction.
items.inference: The utterance of the huṃ-sound alone reduced the foremost demon to ashes.
items.plain_english: With the huṃ-sound alone, he reduced that foremost demon to ashes.
